new_scholarship.description: The Swedish Institute (SI), a Swedish government agency, runs fully funded scholarships for full-time one- or two-year master's studies at Swedish universities. There are two calls: the Scholarship for Global Professionals and Pioneering Women in STEM. The Global Professionals call is open to citizens of 34 listed countries and covers full tuition fees paid directly to the university, a monthly allowance of SEK 12,000, a one-time travel grant of SEK 15,000 (SEK 10,000 for Armenia, Azerbaijan, Belarus, Georgia, Moldova and Ukraine) and membership of the SI Network for Global Professionals. new_scholarship.description: The Lester B. Pearson International Scholarship is the University of Toronto's most prestigious award for international students, recognising outstanding academic achievement, creativity and leadership potential. It is described as "one of the largest scholarship programs for international students in Canada", naming an average of 37 scholars annually with more than $12 million in funding awarded in 2024, and covering students from 188 countries. The scholarship covers tuition, books, incidental fees and full residence support for four years, is tenable only at the University of Toronto for first-entry undergraduate programmes, and is restricted to the recipient's top choice of programme at the time scholarship decisions are made.
